query: How do I get a red wine stain out of a carpet?
answer:
Act fast. Blot the spill with a clean white cloth or paper towels, pressing from the outside of the stain toward the middle. Don't rub, because that spreads the wine and pushes it deeper into the fibres [1][2].

Next, mix about 1 tablespoon of dish soap and 1 tablespoon of white vinegar into 2 cups of warm water. Sponge it onto the stain, then keep blotting with a dry cloth until the colour stops coming up [2][3]. Rinse the spot with a little cold water and blot it dry.

If a mark is still there, use 3% hydrogen peroxide mixed with a bit of dish soap; one common ratio is about 2 parts peroxide to 1 part soap. Leave it on for a few minutes, then blot and rinse [1][3]. Peroxide can bleach carpet, so test it on a hidden spot first and only use it on light-coloured carpet. On dark carpet, stick with the vinegar mix [3]. If neither works, try a commercial carpet stain remover or call a professional cleaner.
